title: Returning a Hospital Bed: Pickup and Recovery Terms — Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces
content:
**Terms.** A Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed may be declined before delivery at no charge. A rented bed is returned only at the patient's or family's own confirmation: a rented bed is returned only after a return-pickup request on this bed record is approved. Pickup follows within the class's pickup lead business days; a private rental is charged the class's private rental pickup fee. A bed recovered damaged beyond normal wear is charged the class's damage-beyond-wear charge; a bed still not recovered the class's unrecovered-equipment days after the confirmed pickup date is charged the class's not-recovered charge. A return after the patient's death is never charged damage or pickup fees.

The pickup lead, the pickup fee, the damage charge, the unrecovered-equipment days and the not-recovered charge are the bed class's published figures.

## The terms by moment

| Moment | Term |
|---|---|
| Before delivery | The bed may be declined at no charge |
| Return of a rented bed | Only at the patient's or family's own confirmation, and only after a return-pickup request on this bed record is approved |
| After the confirmed return | Pickup within the class's pickup lead business days |
| Pickup of a private rental | The private rental pickup fee is charged |
| Bed recovered damaged beyond normal wear | The damage-beyond-wear charge is made |
| Bed still not recovered the class's unrecovered-equipment days after the confirmed pickup date | The not-recovered charge is made |
| Return after the patient's death | No damage fee and no pickup fee, in any case |

The approval of the return-pickup request is read from the system record of requests attached to this bed record — its type, its status and the bed record it concerns.

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. **Declined before delivery.** A family declines a bed whose record is still order received: no charge.
2. **Private rental returned in good order.** The private rental pickup fee is charged.
3. **Private rental returned after the patient's death, with damage beyond wear.** Neither the damage fee nor the pickup fee is charged.
4. **Coverage rental, bed not handed over.** On a hypothetical day 10 after the confirmed pickup date the unrecovered-equipment period of 30 days has not yet passed; on a hypothetical day 45 the bed is still not recovered after that period and the not-recovered charge is made.
5. **Return request not yet approved.** The rented bed is not returned until a return-pickup request on this bed record is approved.
